messages:
opsbot: INCIDENT CREATED — hosted-inference us-east-1 gateway 5xx spike. Alerts: 502/504/500. Starting war room. thread:1745556667

hannah_support: seeing ~1200 errors/min from customer A and multiple PSAT alerts. Customers reporting timeouts in their dashboards.

sasha_oncall: I'm on it, scaling and routing checks first. Are we seeing high queue depth or specific model routes?

raj_sre: initial sweep — gateway p95 latency up, backend inference pool returning 502s intermittently. KV cache hit rate dropped ~30%. Could be backend saturation causing proxy errors.

moritz_runtime: runtime logs show frequent "KVCache: miss" then OOM reclaim on some pods. Also seeing spiky token generation loops extending seq length to 8k for some requests.

hannah_support: reproduced with a simple curl from customer request body: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","input":"<long chain of messages>"}'
```

Responses flip between 200 and 502 within retries.

lina_platform: rolling temporary circuit-breaker policy tweak to reduce inflight for heavy models, lowering concurrency from 60 -> 20 for rwd-large in us-east-1. Will also pin fallback to rwd-medium for routes tagged as non-critical.

sasha_oncall: doing the CB tweak now. Deploy-bot: start rollout to us-east-1 cb-policy-2024-07-05.

deploy-bot: rollout started: cb-policy-2024-07-05 -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (expected 3m).

raj_sre: after 50% rollout, error rate dropped ~65% and p95 latency back to baseline for many routes. Still seeing a small fraction of long-tail 504s from older keepalive connections.

moritz_runtime: adding knob to evict oversized KV entries earlier and to cap generated sequence length server-side at 2048 for burst windows. Will ship canary patch in 15m.

hannah_support: customers notified via DM that we're mitigating with temporary fallback and CB change. CSMs flagged top-5 impacted customers for handoff.

emily_csm: got the list, reaching out to impacted accounts with ETA and workaround (pin to smaller model).

raj_sre: next steps: 1) confirm canary patch stabilizes KV eviction (owner: moritz_runtime, ETA: +1h) 2) postmortem writeup (owner: sasha_oncall, ETA: EOD) 3) run workload audit for requests causing >2048 tokens (owner: hannah_support + platform, ETA: +2d) 4) improve circuit-breaker autotune to degrade gracefully (owner: lina_platform, ETA: +5d).

sasha_oncall: logging action items in pager duty and will open a postmortem doc. Please add notes if you own any additional mitigations.

moritz_runtime: canary patch deployed to 20% (canary id cb-evict-1745). Observability: KV miss ratio falling and OOMs stopped on canary hosts.

raj_sre: recommend follow-up safety net: enable short-term rate-limiter per-API-key for heavy seq requests to prevent noisy neighbors. Lina, can you scope?

lina_platform: yes, I'll size a limiter config and propose defaults. Might be configurable per-tenant via the console. ETA: +3d for proposal, +7d for rollout.

hannah_support: final customer impact summary: ~12 customers saw errors >5% of calls, top 3 impacted had retries and UX failures. No data loss reported.

emily_csm: I've scheduled synchronous updates for the top-3 customers at 1600 UTC.

sasha_oncall: marking incident as mitigated at 1745556910 once rollout completed and error rates dropped to acceptable SLO. We'll keep monitoring for 2 hours.

opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigated. root cause suspected: combination of KV cache churn + oversized generation requests causing backend memory pressure -> gateway 5xx fallthrough.

raj_sre: postmortem notes to include: timeline, root cause analysis, mitigation steps taken, follow-ups, and customer comms template. I will draft and share a link.

moritz_runtime: follow-up patch to be promoted after extra canary runs. I'll also add more defensive metrics for KV eviction stalls.

lina_platform: will add CB autotune ticket and rate-limiter RFC to backlog.

sasha_oncall: assigning owners in the postmortem doc. If no objections, we'll close the war room after the 2h monitoring window. :thumbsup:

hannah_support: no objections, thanks everyone for quick response.

emily_csm: thanks — I'll post customer follow-ups after the 1600 UTC sync.

opsbot: WAR ROOM CLOSED (monitoring window started).
